column2: ENGLISH

The Shadowmen are a constant blight on your lands, forever stepping out of line and encroaching into your territory with their raids. Their most recent raid was more daring than usual, they ventured deeper into your lands and stole crops and materials from the [Root.GetPeasantNamePlural], captured many of the women and even killed some guards. They must be taught a lesson.
I cannot defend every peasant, we must let it slide this time.
The best offence is a good defence, we should fortify our vulnerabilities
The raiders return and are halted by your defences.
The raiders return and break through your defences.
The raiders do not return.
I will personally lead an attack against them
You shall set out to attack the Shadowmen
My [Root.GetMyMarshalName] shall teach them to not return
Your [Root.GetMyMarshalName], [Root.job_marshal.GetTitledFirstName], sets out to attack the Shadowmen

It has been a while since the Shadowmen have dared to raid deep into your lands again, but emboldened by their recent victory they once again attack. This time they are met by the superior defences you had constructed after the last time and they succeed in halting the attackers, unable to break through many of the raiders die before their leader finally calls for them to retreat.

It has been a while since the Shadowmen have dared to raid deep into your lands again, but emboldened by their recent victory they once again attack. This time they are met by the superior defences you had constructed after the last time yet they manage to find a weak point! Once again they steal and murder their way through your land...

It has been a while since the Shadowmen mounted their raid deep into your lands, it seems they are for the moment satisfied with their loot from the last attack. Whilst this is good as it means your [Root.GetPeasantNamePlural] are safe, it also means all the gold you spend fortifying your defences has been wasted...
Take that you vile brigands!
What a waste...
Hopefully they never return

You and your men have successfully tracked and closed in on the camp that the raiders from the Shadowlands have made. You can see a few peasant women being held captive and cattle stolen from the farms. Now is the time to strike...
Charge!!!
We should sneak our way into their camp
The attack is a success.
The attack is repelled.

You and your men approach the camp and all is silent until the screams of your troops as you charge, switfly followed by the screams of the Shadowmen as they are killed. As the screams continue off into the night you and your men set off home with all that was stolen, the night has been good.

You and your men approach the camp and all is silent until the screams of your troops as you charge, switfly followed by the screams of your troops as the Shadowmen fell them one by one. Seeing that all is lost you order the retreat, you have lost a lot this night. But the next time you shall be ready.
That will show them not to trifle with us!
This is terrible!

Your [Root.GetMyMarshalName] [Root.job_marshal.GetTitledFirstName] returns from attacking the Shadowmen, [Root.job_marshal.GetSheHe] reports that they had great success and reclaimed all that was stolen from you. The Shadowmen are unlikely to try another attack anytime soon.

Your [Root.GetMyMarshalName] ,[Root.job_marshal.GetTitledFirstName], returns from attacking the Shadowmen and [Root.job_marshal.GetSheHe] reports that they failed in their goal. Many of your troops were lost and none of the stolen goods were reclaimed.
Good work [Root.job_marshal.GetTitledFirstName]! That'll teach those savages!
Your incompetance has cost us greatly!
The Unification of Asshai

You are sat in your chambers one evening pondering to yourself about how to negotiate a complex trade deal when suddenly you hear repeated knocks at your door. You sigh and get up to open it only to see a servant with a note, you take the note and return to your chambers and open it to see that once again your Shadowmen neighbours have raided into your territory again, this time the filth from [unite_shadowlander_target.Capital.GetName].\nThose savages just do not know their place, you are the [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and these wild tribesmen are nothing compared to you. yet they do not realise this...\nMaybe you should make them? Unite all of The Shadows under your rule as their leader and reign over them as a noble of Asshai should do. They would never come peacefully though, but would it be worth it to finally unify the region?
The Shadowmen shall be subdued under my rule!
They are no concern of mine
[This.GetTitledFirstName] decides [This.GetHerHis] next action in [This.GetHerHis] unification of Asshai.
You have finished your most recent war against the Shadowmen and were victorious. The measley tribesmen cannot stand against your might!
The next savage must be conquered
This is enough, there is no need for further bloodshed
All of Asshai is mine!
All conquered lands shall be returned to the Shadowmen tribes and [This.GetTitledFirstName]'s quest to unify Asshai is over.
The Land of Shadows

Asshai, "the pass beneath the shadow", a solemn place of quiet turmoil where the placid nights are only puncuated by the echoed screams of the demons beyond the mountains. Here no spell is forbidden, no torture too dark and no taboo forsaken.\nAnd I am their ruler!\n
I proclaim myself the Shadow King!
No, there has never been a single ruling family in Asshai, it would not be tolerated
Crown of Shadows

The Crown of Shadows was forged to be the representation of the power held by the monarch of Asshai. To show their dominion of the shadows of their native lands and how they shall spread across all of the world.

A man warn from the road speaking in whispers approaches you, he appears wildly foreign not covering his face as is the custom in Asshai.\n"My master, the descendant of the Yellow Emperors of Old and the true God Emperor of Yi Ti, brings you a proposal. Support him in his war for Yi Ti and you will be handsomly rewarded"
Yi Ti shall know the might of Asshai
Upon victory in the war you will be rewarded with 250W¤ and 10 year long alliance with [From.GetTitledFirstName]\n
Begone beggar, your supposed "Sorcerer King" does not frighten me
